screen.free-my-hotbar.title: Free My Hotbar
screen.free-my-hotbar.help: Choose which hotbar slots to keep free.
screen.free-my-hotbar.mode.present: This server has the mod: locked slots never receive picked-up items.
screen.free-my-hotbar.mode.absent: No mod on this server: items are picked up, then moved out of locked slots.
screen.free-my-hotbar.mode.unknown: Checking whether this server has the mod...
screen.free-my-hotbar.fallback.move_or_d: Move items, or drop them if full
screen.free-my-hotbar.block_gui: Block my own clicks into locked slots: %s
screen.free-my-hotbar.evict_immediately: Move items out right away, even while moving: %s
Faster, but some servers ignore inventory actions made while you move.
chat.free-my-hotbar.fallback_notice: Free My Hotbar: this server doesn't have the mod, so items are picked up and then moved out of locked slots.
chat.free-my-hotbar.drop_limit: Free My Hotbar: slot %s keeps being refilled by the server, so the mod stopped dropping its contents — a dropped stack can simply be picked back up. Free some inventory space, or unlock the slot.
chat.free-my-hotbar.fallback_off: Free My Hotbar: this server doesn't have the mod and the fallback is off, so locked slots are not enforced here.
